scope: Source-only preimplementation review of proposed T57 organization checkpoint; no product, test, fixture, native, or runtime changes

source_contract.extension_instruction: CLAUDE.md:99-104 states the visible active organization may come from device choice, account last-active, startup, or first current membership; a ladder result is not written as device choice.
source_contract.canonical_organizations_state: ../common-docs/systems/account/organizations/STATE.md rules 11-14: shell chooses the visible active organization at load, validates current membership, and carries it on every request; server-side substitution is forbidden.
source_contract.attribution_limit: The load-ladder statements above are from current on-disk CLAUDE.md and canonical Organizations STATE. They are not attributed to the conversation-supplied AGENTS snapshot, which was device-choice-only.
source_contract.source_revision_context: .research/t57-organization-contract-20261008.json records the frozen active-org implementation and prior receipt boundary; this review checked current on-disk source paths independently.

feasibility.approved_fixture: The current hosted profile organization fixture is name-only: scripts/hosted-profile-route.mjs:89-101 validates and returns approved_organization_name only. A name cannot bind the request to an organization UUID.
feasibility.uuid_source_candidate: tests/browser/files-saved-native-acceptance.mjs:privateConfig requires approved_organization_id plus approved_organization_name, but that is a separate Files fixture; reuse is conditional on exact name match and a private current-membership check for that UUID, not fixture presence alone.
feasibility.membership_contract: src/lib/org/active-org.ts:listMemberOrganizations reads canonical mbr_for_user and active organization rows; the shell load ladder uses that membership set. This is a source-supported validation route for the exact fixture UUID and name.
feasibility.product_request: src/lib/tools/manual-server.ts:getManualServerToolDefinition calls apiGet('/tools/test/list'); src/features/tools/ToolsView.tsx expands server-owned Records detail by calling that function. The ordinary client request path adds the resolved active organization header and refuses authenticated non-exempt requests without one (src/lib/api/client.ts:755-758). CDP observation of this actual product GET is therefore feasible without injecting storage or headers.

required_acceptance: Require a private fixture containing both approved name and UUID; independently establish that the signed-in admin currently belongs to that active, non-archived organization using the canonical membership contract. Do not trust the Files fixture ID until its exact name and current membership both match.

After rendered admin identity and approved organization name checks, open Tools > Records detail and observe the real /tools/test/list request in CDP. Require successful product response and the observed X-Organization-Id to equal the independently verified fixture UUID.

Keep admin role/profile checks. Missing UUID, stale/nonmember UUID, wrong rendered name, absent or mismatched request header, and failed request must remain failures. Do not synthesize a header, write extension storage, or turn the organization checkpoint into a pass based on the label alone.

For the regression guard, demonstrate the current storage-only check fails on the documented ladder state while the replacement passes only with matching independent fixture membership and observed product request lineage; wrong UUID/header and absent header mutations must fail.
review.precision_gap: The proposal is not yet executable with the existing hosted T57 organization secret because its schema contains only approved_organization_name. The separate Files fixture is a candidate source, not proof it is the same approved T57 organization. No source evidence here establishes that fixture alignment or a new fixture's current membership.
review.scope_limit: This is source feasibility only. No native execution, current fixture inspection, authenticated membership read, product behavior, or T57 acceptance is claimed.
